_comment: C1 first-parse jail seccomp profile (RED-COUNCIL C1 / Captain finding #1's sibling). STRICTER than infer-llama-server.json: this container never serves a network connection at all (compose --network=none / k8s Job with no NetworkPolicy egress at all), never spawns a child process, and touches only stdin/stdout + the bounded read-only filesystem the interpreter itself needs. No bind/connect/accept/socket family at all — this is the 'distinct ephemeral seccomp-strict, network=none, torn-down step' the brief calls for, structurally separated from the serving ring-fence's (looser, network-capable) profile.

syscalls._comment: minimal set for a CPython interpreter reading stdin, running pure-Python struct-unpack parsing, and writing stdout — NO network syscalls at all (bind/listen/accept/connect/socket/sendto/recvfrom are all absent, not merely policy-denied by a network namespace — belt-and-suspenders against a namespace misconfiguration).
explicit deny — same post-RCE recon/escape toolkit as infer-llama-server.json, PLUS the entire networking syscall family (this jail must never open a socket of any kind).
